theorems.name: Submission.bv_mollifier_tendsto_L1
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Rn n → ℝ) (ρ : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (σ : ℕ → ℝ), Integrable F volume → (∀ j, Continuous (ρ j)) → (∀ j x, 0 ≤ ρ j x) → (∀ j, Function.support (ρ j) ⊆ ball 0 (σ j)) → (∀ j, ∫ x, ρ j x = 1) → Tendsto σ atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫⁻ x, ‖convolution (ρ j) F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x - F x‖ₑ) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
